doc_title: APPLICATION FOR SEVERANCE OF JOINT OWNERSHIP
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR SEVERANCE OF JOINT OWNERSHIP
when_used: Joint proprietors apply to sever the joint proprietorship and to be registered instead as proprietors in common in stated undivided shares.

body_text.text: The joint Proprietors HEREBY APPLY to the Land Registrar to sever their joint proprietorship in the above-mentioned Title and apply to be registered as proprietors in common* in the following undivided shares:-
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act, 2012 (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act, 2012 (No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, if any:
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereof have signed this document this................... day of ………………...…………………..20…………….

registry_block: REGISTERED and SEALED this ……… day of ………………… 20……
foot_notes: **The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.prompt: Address of each joint proprietor, in the same order as their names and numbered 1, 2, 3 and 4 as the form prints them

custom_fields.label: Proprietor the first undivided share is held in favour of
